hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, along the curb line

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No streetlights are visible, which significantly reduces pedestrian safety and visibility at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire streetscape

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: The lack of paved walkways forces pedestrians to walk on uneven dirt or directly in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the block

hazards.name: Walkway Obstructions
hazards.description: Large green dumpsters block the paved apron on the right side, further pushing pedestrians into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and mid-ground

hazards.name: Poor Surface Condition
hazards.description: The unpaved path on the left is uneven and likely muddy, creating a tripping hazard and accessibility barrier.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long, windowless brick wall provides no active surveillance or interest, which can decrease the perceived safety and comfort of the pedestrian environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, the brick building wall

hazards.name: Inadequate Sidewalk Width and Condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is narrow and obstructed by trees and debris, while the left side lacks a clear paved walkway, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street edge

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street limits sightlines between drivers and pedestrians who may step into the road.
hazards.location_in_image: Both curbsides throughout the block

hazards.name: Lack of vertical separation
hazards.description: There is no curb or barrier between the paved walkway and the area where vehicles park and travel.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, where the paved sidewalk meets the dirt ground

hazards.name: Unpaved roadway surface
hazards.description: The dirt surface adjacent to the sidewalk can be uneven and creates dust or mud, impacting pedestrian comfort and accessibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom foreground of the image

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: Total absence of sidewalks or designated walking paths forces pedestrians into the path of moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway length

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk appears narrow, providing limited space for pedestrians to pass one another comfortably.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible behind the parked white SUV.

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas visible along this stretch of the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway visible.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expanding the sidewalk width to meet modern accessibility standards, providing a clear path of travel for all users.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Installation of physical traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain consistently low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the nearest intersections to improve visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Relocate the dumpster to a designated off-street area or a repurposed parking stall to restore the pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to complete the pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Intersection Safety Improvements
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and curb ramps at the upcoming intersection to provide safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Waste Management Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate dumpsters to a designated off-street enclosure or a parking-lane 'corral' to keep the walkway clear.

interventions.title: Utility Undergrounding or Relocation
interventions.description: Move utility poles to the edge of the right-of-way or underground them to provide an unobstructed pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk and Curb Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk with a raised curb and a furniture/planting buffer to clearly separate pedestrians from the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening/Bulb-outs
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane area around the tree to provide a consistent, accessible clear width for all users.

interventions.title: Permeable Pavement/Root Protection
interventions.description: Use flexible or permeable paving materials around the tree to prevent root heave and maintain a level walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters where space permits to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Clear Sidewalk Obstructions
interventions.description: Relocate waste containers to designated off-street areas or on-street parking stalls to restore the continuous pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Construct Paved Sidewalk
interventions.description: Install a concrete sidewalk to provide a stable, dedicated space for pedestrians separated from vehicle areas.

interventions.title: Install Curbing
interventions.description: Add a raised curb to physically separate the pedestrian area from the vehicle parking and travel area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to improve visibility and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or underground the utilities to provide a clear, unobstructed path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Roadway Paving and Curbing
interventions.description: Pave the roadway edge to the curb to eliminate mud and provide a stable surface for drainage and traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Apply painted lane markings to organize vehicle flow and clearly define the roadway space.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide safe separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Dedicated Waste Storage
interventions.description: Create designated off-street or recessed areas for dumpsters to ensure they do not obstruct pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Shared Street Design
interventions.description: If full sidewalks are not feasible, implement a 'woonerf' or shared street design with traffic calming to prioritize pedestrian movement.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Introduce street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the ends of the block to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Install Raised Curb
interventions.description: Provide a vertical curb to clearly define the pedestrian zone and prevent vehicle encroachment onto the walkway.

interventions.title: Roadway Paving
interventions.description: Pave the adjacent roadway to provide a stable, predictable surface for all users and improve drainage.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with street trees and low plantings to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the walkway and the street.

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Design
interventions.description: Implement a shared street design using textured paving, signage, and landscaping to clearly indicate pedestrian priority and slow vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Parking and Loading Management
interventions.description: Designate specific zones for waste containers and restrict parking near building entrances to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or thin dense shrubbery to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk if the distance between intersections warrants a mid-block connection.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to alert drivers to the pedestrian crossing point.
